# BookCars

> BookCars is an open-source car rental platform comprising an admin management panel, a web frontend, a native mobile application (iOS & Android), and a Node.js REST API backend.

## Overview

BookCars provides end-to-end car rental workflows for single-supplier and multi-supplier marketplace operations. Suppliers manage fleets, availability, and bookings through a dedicated admin portal. Customers search for vehicles based on location, dates, and times, completing bookings via integrated payment gateways (Stripe and PayPal) or pay-at-counter options.

- Repository: https://github.com/aelassas/bookcars
- License: MIT License
- Tech Stack: Node.js, Express, React, TypeScript, React Native (Expo), MongoDB, Docker

## Key Capabilities

- **Fleet & Supplier Management**: Single and multi-supplier modes, contract file uploads, fleet search result limits, vehicle schedulers, and automated notifications.
- **Dynamic Pricing Engine**: Hourly, daily, weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly rate rules with date-based price adjustments, price change rates, and discount handling.
- **Locations & Search**: Hierarchical location modeling (Countries, Cities, Parking Spots) with geolocation coordinates and map UI integration.
- **Payments & Checkout**: Stripe (Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link) and PayPal integrations. Supports Pay in Full, Pay Deposit, and Pay Later options.
- **Authentication**: Social Sign-In (Google, Facebook, Apple) and traditional email/password credentials with role-based authorization (Admin, Supplier, Customer).
- **Localization**: Multi-language (English, French, Spanish) and multi-currency formatting support.
